title: AEES Teaching Various Post Recruitment 2026
summary: Atomic Energy Education Society (AEES) has released a notification on its official website for the Recruitment of Examination of Teaching & Non-Teaching Various Posts. This recruitment is for 254 positions. The AEES application form has started on 02 November 2026 , and candidates can apply until 22 November 2026 . Candidates must check the complete details for AEES Teaching Various Post Recruitment 2026 Provided below. ( Advt. No. 01/2026 )
qualification: Candidates must have a Master’s Degree with at least 50% marks & B.Ed. with (50% Marks) from recognized Institution/University. Working as Principal (Level 12) & 03 Years as Vice Principal (Level 10) Combined service of 12 years as PGT (Entry Level 8 as per 7th CPC) and Vice Principal (Entry Level 10 as per 7th CPC) Computer Knowledge
